name: cua-hard/psyc3150-late-resubmission-grading
description: As TA for PSYC 3150, post the remaining Lab Report 3 scores and the Lab Report 2 resubmission scores in the Canvas gradebook by applying the long course-policy PDF (late penalty per started day, 15-minute grace, latest attempt, TA promises void, 48-hour SAS flexible deadlines counted from the end of the window and never retroactive, Dean-verified absence waiver, 5-day cut-off, 85% resubmission cap, one resubmission per term, higher-of rule, 7-day window) to UTC submission times from a CSV export and to the approvals and letters in Gmail, then sync the TA tracker in Google Sheets and write a grade-entry CSV.
